newsitem.title: UK: N. Sea crude slow to trade after outright gains.
newsitem.headline: N. Sea crude slow to trade after outright gains.

text.p: Physical North Sea crude saw light activity over the day as traders adjusted to the higher outright levels.
IPE Oct Brent gained 60 cents on the day to trade at $23.48 a barrel by 1652 GMT. As the contract came off the highs, intermonth talk and CFD levels moved in line.
Brent Oct/Nov traded as high as +74 cents but fell in late talk to +69/70 cents while the actively traded Nov/Dec slipped to +65/68 cents.
Of the two Sept 26-28 Brent cargoes turning wet today, one was kept by BP and Shell U.K. was clocked with the other.
